info.cls_ename: Continuing Education Bachelor's Program of Interior Design

description.describe_ch: 課程分兩方面，（一）從生理學、心理學、電腦、工業設計、工業安全等領域探討使用者的各項生理及心理之限制及需要,以及認識正確的產品設計與正確尺寸的應用；（二）建築空間的基本人體尺寸、空間尺寸與生活基本機能的認識。課程重點置於室內設計時之符合人體工學之尺度的應用。
description.describe_eh: Ergonomics is an interdisciplinary course that involving physiology, psychology, computer, industrial design, industrial safety, etc. The purpose of this course is toward: (1) To use the human factors principles during design process of a product or a system to maximize the usability and avoid any possible human errors; (2) The acknowledge and applying of human dimension, space dimension and functions of human life while designing an Interior space.

targets.describe_ch: 知識重點置於室內設計與使用者之立場去理解與此相關之人體工學及相關尺寸；可描述人體工學的用途；
targets.describe_en: This knowledge focuses on how to use and understand ergonomics and related dimensions from interior designer and user's side.Can describe the usage of ergonomics.

targets.describe_ch: 能夠理解人體工學之用途及其在室內設計中的重要性；能夠以使用者立場去理解人體工學對於使用者之重要性；能夠理解人體工學之社會責任；
targets.describe_en: Can understand the usage of ergonomics and the importance on the interior design.Can understand the importance of ergonomics from the user's side.Can understand the social responsibility of the ergonomics.

targets.describe_ch: 能夠將人體工學知識應用到室內設計之中；能夠將人體工學知識應用到室內工程之中；
targets.describe_en: To know how to use the knowledge of ergonomics on the interior design.To know how to use the knowledge of ergonomics on the interior works.
